name: Helplessness
overview: Scripture reveals that helplessness is met with divine provision and grace, calling believers to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding. Even in moments of profound abandonment, as Jesus expressed on the cross, God’s presence sustains His people. The Spirit intercedes on behalf of our weaknesses, especially when we do not know how to pray, assuring us that God actively aids us in our helplessness. Believers are encouraged to approach God in faith, confident that He hears and answers prayer, and to extend forgiveness and mercy as reflections of His saving work.
